summary.intent: Fix the SDK's uploadFile() hardcoding GCM encryption for all files, when media files >256KB should use CTR mode for streaming playback. Also debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging.
summary.outcome: Both issues fixed: CTR encryption now correctly selected for streaming media uploads via centralized encryption-mode module in sdk-core; BYO-IPFS 400/403 errors traced to missing PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint (setByoStatus was dead code) and wrong ipns-publish payload in load test. Two PRs created (#399, #400), both reviewed and iteratively refined.

repo: selectEncryptionMode() existed only in the web app's streaming-crypto.service.ts and was never called for new SDK uploads — only for the duplicate-file re-encrypt path
setByoStatus() in VaultService was dead code — no controller endpoint exposed it, meaning BYO mode could never be enabled via the API (web app Settings UI was also non-functional for this)
The load test's ipns-publish step was sending { ipnsName, cid } but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires { ipnsName, record, metadataCid } — a signed IPNS record
tee-worker was relocated from root /tee-worker/ to /apps/tee-worker/ in Phase 35 merge
STREAMING_MIME_TYPES is an explicit allowlist (not audio/*) — not all audio formats benefit from streaming (e.g. audio/wav is uncompressed)
The .husky/commit-msg hook chains to commit-msg.pre-entire (commitlint) via the Entire CLI wrapper; both must be committed for CI to work
orval regeneration creates new model files and directories (admin/, migration/) that must all be staged — partial staging causes CI typecheck failures
API test files use jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern which loses mock method types after module.get() — a systemic issue across the codebase

code.finding: Previously hardcoded encryptAesGcm and encryptionMode: 'GCM' — now accepts optional encryptionMode param and branches to CTR path
uploadFile() now calls selectEncryptionMode() (imported from sdk-core) before delegating to sdkCore.uploadFile()
New centralized module: STREAMING_MIME_TYPES set, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD (256KB), selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size), normalizeEncryptionMode(value)
Local selectEncryptionMode(file: File) replaced with thin wrapper delegating to sdk-core's selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size)
New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint added, wiring the previously dead setByoStatus() service method
createByoClientPool() now enables BYO mode on each account via the new endpoint after creation; filters out failed accounts and throws if none succeed
ipns-publish step replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord() from sdk-core; createSdkContext() hoisted outside the per-iteration loop
vi.mock('@cipherbox/sdk-core') bare factory pattern replaced with importOriginal spread — bare factory drops all exports not explicitly re-declared
mockRequest must be typed as RequestWithUser (not Request & { user }) to satisfy controller method signatures

workflow: When orval regenerates the API client, stage the entire packages/api-client/src/ directory — not just specific files — to avoid missing new model files/directories
After centralizing a shared utility, use importOriginal spread in Vitest mocks to prevent future export additions from silently breaking tests
CI typecheck failures from missing generated files are caused by partial staging of orval output — always check git status after generation
Pre-existing test type errors follow a pattern: jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> loses mock methods after module.get() — use the mock object directly instead
Dead service methods with no controller endpoint should be verified against the web app UI to confirm the feature is actually working end-to-end

friction: orval API client regeneration requires the API server to be running with the new build — can't generate from source alone
Accidentally wrote openapi.json to apps/api/ (cwd) instead of packages/api-client/ during manual generation — had to remove and push a fix
GitHub GraphQL API timed out repeatedly; had to fall back to REST for PR review threads
Pre-existing test errors in 9+ API spec files required significant cleanup before typecheck would pass — all used the same broken jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> anti-pattern
.husky/commit-msg.pre-entire was in .git/info/exclude (local-only) so force-add was needed to commit it for CI
Background agent for fixing 3 API test files ran in parallel with manual fixes — work was duplicated but harmless
Two todo copies (pending + done) for the SDK GCM fix were both merged to main due to branch timing
